run_evaluation: run the Robbie evaluation pipeline with a dataset, predictor, and metric via CLI
build_dataset: build a Robbie Dataset instance from CLI args using Dataset.build
build_predictor: build a Robbie Predictor instance from CLI args using Predictor.build
build_metric: build a Robbie Metric instance from CLI args using Metric.build
run_runner: run the Robbie Runner with a dataset, predictor, metric, result dir, and num samples
